detail.body:
## Overview

ROCm side of Step-5-Preview support. #61727 adds [stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview](https://huggingface.co/stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview) for NVIDIA (SM90/SM103 only). This PR adds the `amd/` implementation under `vllm/models/step5/`, with portable Triton kernels for compressed sparse attention (CSA) and 3-layer MTP. Validated on 8x MI300X.

The `step5` reasoning and tool parsers come from #61727. Until it lands, the existing `step3p5` parsers handle Step-5 output.

## Claims

- Step-5-Preview (FP8, TP8) serves on ROCm with text and image input, with no CUDA-only dependencies.
- CSA runs on the 23 full-attention layers for prefill, chunked prefill and decode. Its state lives in two side caches managed by the existing KV-cache manager, with no scheduler changes and no GPU-to-CPU syncs.
- MTP works with `--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'`: same GSM8K accuracy, about 2.3x faster (earlier revision).
- Step-5's hub `tokenizer_class` is overridden in vLLM, as for Step-3.7.

### Serving command (ROCm, MTP enabled)

<details>
<summary>Serve Step-5-Preview on 8x MI300X</summary>

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --mm-encoder-attn-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \
  --mm-processor-cache-type shm \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":1,"video":0}' \
  --reasoning-parser step3p5 \
  --tool-call-parser step3p5 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --speculative-config '{"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}'
```

After #61727 merges, switch to `--reasoning-parser step5 --tool-call-parser step5`.

| Flag | Why |
|---|---|
| `--moe-backend triton` | Required. Every MoE layer clamps SwiGLU at 7, and AITER's block-FP8 MoE does not apply that clamp yet. |
| `--mm-encoder-*`, `--limit-mm-per-prompt` | Image input through the perception-encoder tower. |
| `step3p5` parsers | Step-5 uses Step-3.5's `<think>` and `<tool_call>` format. |
| KV cache dtype | Keep the default (BF16). Sparse layers reject other dtypes. |


</details>

### How this fits with #61727

| | #61727 (NVIDIA) | This PR (ROCm) |
|---|---|---|
| Platforms | SM90, SM103 | ROCm, validated on gfx942 |
| Sparse attention | FlashInfer + Triton | Triton |
| New custom ops | 2 `.cu` ops, CUTLASS RMSNorm | None |
| KV cache / scheduler | Reworked for cached region summaries | Side caches through the existing KV-cache manager |
| Indexer Q/W | Sharded by provider group | Sharded by provider group |
| MTP | Yes | Yes, through the Step-3.5 MTP proposer |
| `step5` parsers | Yes | Uses #61727's |

Whichever PR lands second should turn `vllm/models/step5/__init__.py` into the usual platform switch (`nvidia/` on CUDA, `amd/` on ROCm), and keep one `Step5Config` and one set of tokenizer entries.

## Validation

**Setup:** 8x MI300X (gfx942), TP8, `max-model-len 32768`, vLLM ROCm nightly `3f1bcfd82` with this branch applied.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| GSM8K, full 1319, 5-shot chat (earlier revision) | 97.2%, and 97.4% with MTP |
| GSM8K, 200-question sample, MTP (final revision) | 96.0% |
| Needle in a haystack, 4k / 16k / 30k, 3 depths, 3 trials | 27/27 |
| Image input: shapes, counting, reading text | 3/3 correct |
| Prefix caching, shared ~22k-token prefix | 66% of prompt tokens from cache, answers correct |
| MTP acceptance, 3 draft tokens (earlier revision) | Mean acceptance length 3.1 to 3.3 |
| `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`, long chunked prefill + 15 concurrent decodes | No syncs |
| Prefill, 26k-token prompt | TTFT 2.7 s (3.7 to 5.0 s before K/V was written without dense attention) |
| `step3p5` parsers on Step-5 output, stream and non-stream | Pass |
| `tests/models/test_initialization.py` (Step5ForConditionalGeneration) | Pass |
| Unit tests: paged CSA kernels (6), MTP config override (2, CPU) | Pass |
| MI355X (gfx950) GSM8K, 5-shot, 1319 by [@jamesETsmith](https://github.com/jamesETsmith) | 96.97% strict / 97.27% flexible; 96.59% / 97.04% with MTP |
| MI355X (gfx950) GPQA-Diamond, 198-question, zero-shot CoT by [@jamesETsmith](https://github.com/jamesETsmith) | 85.86% (170/198); 85.35% (169/198) with MTP (raw lower bounds, 16k gen budget) |
| MI355X (gfx950) NIAH single-key + multikey-2/3, 40 samples per task and context by [@jamesETsmith](https://github.com/jamesETsmith) | 100% at 32K / 128K / 256K, with and without MTP |

Big thanks to [@jamesETsmith](https://github.com/jamesETsmith) for coming up with the extensive MI355X (gfx950) validation with GSM8K, GPQA-Diamond, and RULER-style needle-in-a-haystack up to 256K documented [in this comment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61837#issuecomment-6206831125).

About 8% of GSM8K items timed out in lm-eval's client at concurrency 64 because of long reasoning traces; they were re-asked with the same settings and scored with lm-eval's strict regex. Raw lm-eval scores were 89.2% (CSA) and 88.7% (CSA + MTP).

The 600B checkpoint does not fit in CI, so end-to-end results come from the MI300X runs. The unit tests run on any GPU runner.

## Details

- **Layout:** `vllm/models/step5/{common,amd}`. Triton kernels with explicit OCP E4M3 rounding, so gfx942 (native FP8 is E4M3FNUZ) selects the same regions as the reference.
- **Side caches:** per-token `[index_k | index_z]` rows and one summary per 8-token region, both through `MLAAttentionSpec`. Paging, prefix caching and freeing come from the KV-cache manager.
- **One custom op:** `vllm::step5_csa_attention` compresses completed regions, scores, picks the top-k and attends over the paged K/V. It is a graph splitting op, so it always sees real per-step metadata.
- **Per-batch metadata:** the index-cache metadata builder computes the token-to-request map, positions and completed-region list once per step from `CommonAttentionMetadata`.
- **K/V write:** `unified_kv_cache_update`, ordered before the CSA op through its dummy dependency.
- **Backend:** the sparse layers pin `ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN` on their own `Attention` layer through a Step-3.5 hook, as DeepSeek-V3.2 and OpenPangu do.
- **Indexer sharding:** Q and W are `ColumnParallelLinear` sharded by provider group; K and Z stay replicated.
- **Reuse:** small class hooks in `step3p5.py` and `step3p5_mtp.py` with unchanged defaults. No changes to the scheduler, KV-cache manager, model runner or attention backends.

**Footprint:** model code 1,373 lines (11 files), tests 244 (3), registrations 39 (8), Step-3.5 hooks +21 / -11 (2).

### Limitations

| Limitation | Follow-up |
|---|---|
| Piecewise CUDA graphs only; all numbers above used them | Graph-safe CSA metadata for full graphs |
| BF16 KV cache only on sparse layers | FP8 KV |
| `--moe-backend triton` required | Post-SiLU clamp in AITER's block-FP8 MoE |
| Top-k uses a PyTorch sort | Fused radix select |

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Paged Step-5 CSA kernels vs PyTorch references on scrambled block tables.
+
+Each test mixes requests with their own block-table rows, and prefill, chunked
+prefill and decode rows, since a page- or request-addressing bug reads wrong
+tokens without changing any shape.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.csa import round_e4m3, select_regions
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.csa_paged import (
+    compress_regions_paged,
+    indexer_scores_paged,
+    sparse_attention_paged,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda_alike(), reason="Triton kernels need a GPU"
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+REGION = 8
+PROXY = 256
+
+
+def _e4m3(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return round_e4m3(x).float()
+
+
+def _paged(
+    seqs: list[torch.Tensor], rows_per_page: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Scatter each request's rows into shared pages behind its own row of a
+    shuffled ``[requests, pages]`` block table."""
+    pages = [-(-x.shape[0] // rows_per_page) for x in seqs]
+    perm = torch.randperm(sum(pages) + 3, device=DEVICE).int()
+    table = torch.zeros(len(seqs), max(pages), dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    cache = torch.zeros(
+        (sum(pages) + 3, rows_per_page, *seqs[0].shape[1:]),
+        dtype=seqs[0].dtype,
+        device=DEVICE,
+    )
+    start = 0
+    for r, (x, n) in enumerate(zip(seqs, pages)):
+        table[r, :n] = perm[start : start + n]
+        start += n
+        idx = torch.arange(x.shape[0], device=DEVICE)
+        cache[table[r, idx // rows_per_page].long(), idx % rows_per_page] = x
+    return cache, table
+
+
+def ref_compress(k: torch.Tensor, z: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    regions = k.shape[0] // REGION
+    k = k[: regions * REGION].float().view(regions, REGION, -1)
+    z = z[: regions * REGION].float().view(regions, REGION, -1)
+    w = torch.exp(z - z.amax(dim=1, keepdim=True))
+    return _e4m3((w * k).sum(1) / w.sum(1))
+
+
+def ref_select(scores: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor, topk: int):
+    tokens, groups, _ = scores.shape
+    out = torch.full((tokens, groups, topk + 1), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for t in range(tokens):
+        own = int(positions[t]) // REGION
+        for g in range(groups):
+            order = torch.argsort(-scores[t, g, :own].cpu(), stable=True)[:topk]
+            row = torch.cat([torch.sort(order).values, torch.tensor([own])])
+            out[t, g, : row.numel()] = row.to(torch.int32)
+    return out
+
+
+def ref_attention(q, k, v, regions, req, positions, scale):
+    tokens, heads, _ = q.shape
+    groups = k.shape[2]
+    per_group = heads // groups
+    out = torch.zeros(q.shape, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for t in range(tokens):
+        kr, vr = k[int(req[t])], v[int(req[t])]
+        for g in range(groups):
+            ids = regions[t, g]
+            ids = ids[ids >= 0].long().cpu()
+            cols = (ids[:, None] * REGION + torch.arange(REGION)).flatten()
+            cols = cols[cols <= int(positions[t])]
+            hs = slice(g * per_group, (g + 1) * per_group)
+            p = torch.softmax(
+                q[t, hs].float().cpu() @ kr[cols, g].float().cpu().T * scale, -1
+            )
+            out[t, hs] = p @ vr[cols, g].float().cpu()
+    return out
+
+
+def test_round_e4m3_saturates():
+    x = torch.tensor([447.0, 500.0, -1e4], device=DEVICE)
+    assert round_e4m3(x).tolist() == [448.0, 448.0, -448.0]
+
+
+def test_compress_regions_paged():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    lens = [64, 203]
+    ks = [torch.randn(n, PROXY, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE) for n in lens]
+    zs = [torch.randn(n, PROXY, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE) * 4 for n in lens]
+    zs[1][:, :128] += 200
+    index_cache, index_bt = _paged([torch.cat(kz, -1) for kz in zip(ks, zs)], 64)
+    regions = [n // REGION for n in lens]
+    summary_cache, summary_bt = _paged(
+        [torch.zeros(n, PROXY, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE) for n in regions],
+        4,
+    )
+    work = [(req, r) for req, n in enumerate(regions) for r in range(n)]
+    work = torch.tensor(work + [(-1, -1)] * 3, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    compress_regions_paged(
+        index_cache, summary_cache, index_bt, summary_bt, work, region_size=REGION
+    )
+    for req, n in enumerate(regions):
+        r = torch.arange(n, device=DEVICE)
+        got = summary_cache[summary_bt[req, r // 4].long(), r % 4].float()
+        # Within one E4M3 step: exp and reduction order may differ by an ulp.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            got, ref_compress(ks[req], zs[req]), rtol=0.125, atol=0
+        )
+
+
+def test_indexer_scores_paged():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    groups, regions = 4, 25
+    summaries = [
+        _e4m3(torch.randn(regions, PROXY, device=DEVICE)).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        for _ in range(2)
+    ]
+    summary_cache, summary_bt = _paged(summaries, 8)
+    pos = torch.cat([torch.arange(200), torch.arange(150, 154)]).int().to(DEVICE)
+    req = torch.tensor([0] * 200 + [1] * 4, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    q = torch.randn(len(pos), groups, 4, PROXY, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    w = torch.randn(len(pos), groups, 4, device=DEVICE)
+    got = indexer_scores_paged(
+        q,
+        w,
+        summary_cache,
+        summary_bt,
+        req,
+        pos,
+        max_regions=regions,
+        region_size=REGION,
+    )
+    history = torch.stack(summaries)[req.long()].float()
+    dots = torch.einsum("tghd,trd->tghr", _e4m3(q), history).clamp_min(0)
+    want = (dots * w.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(2)
+    visible = torch.arange(regions, device=DEVICE) < (pos // REGION)[:, None]
+    visible = visible[:, None, :].expand_as(got)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got[visible], want[visible], atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-4)
+    assert torch.isneginf(got[~visible]).all()
+
+
+def test_select_regions_breaks_ties_by_region_id():
+    """Post-ReLU scores are often exactly zero; ties must pick lower ids."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    scores = torch.randn(48, 2, 40, device=DEVICE)
+    scores[scores.abs() < 0.5] = 0.0
+    positions = torch.randint(0, 40 * REGION, (48,), device=DEVICE)
+    got = select_regions(scores, positions, REGION, topk=6)
+    assert torch.equal(got.cpu(), ref_select(scores, positions, 6))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("topk", [6, 512])
+def test_sparse_attention_paged(topk: int):
+    """topk=512 covers the whole history, so it also checks dense equivalence."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    seq_len, heads, groups, dim = 203, 16, 4, 192
+    shape = (2, seq_len, groups, dim)
+    k = torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    v = torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    pos = torch.cat([torch.arange(seq_len), torch.tensor([202])]).int().to(DEVICE)
+    req = torch.tensor([0] * seq_len + [1], dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    q = torch.randn(len(pos), heads, dim, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    scores = torch.randn(len(pos), groups, seq_len // REGION + 1, device=DEVICE)
+    regions = select_regions(scores, pos, REGION, topk)
+
+    kv_cache, bt = _paged([torch.stack([k[r], v[r]], 1) for r in range(2)], 64)
+    got = torch.empty_like(q)
+    sparse_attention_paged(
+        q,
+        kv_cache[:, :, 0],
+        kv_cache[:, :, 1],
+        regions,
+        bt,
+        req,
+        pos,
+        got,
+        region_size=REGION,
+        scale=dim**-0.5,
+    )
+    want = ref_attention(q, k, v, regions, req, pos, dim**-0.5)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got.float().cpu(), want, atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Step-5 CSA metadata vs a direct reference.
+
+A region ``r`` of a request is summarised in the step that caches its last token:
+``computed < (r + 1) * region_size <= seq_len``. Getting this wrong does not crash;
+it leaves stale or missing summaries and silently picks worse regions.
+"""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.v1.attention.utils import BatchSpec, create_common_attn_metadata
+from vllm.models.step5.common.csa_cache import (
+    Step5CSAMetadataBuilder,
+    _completed_regions,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+REGION = 8
+
+
+def _reference_regions(seq_lens: list[int], query_lens: list[int]) -> set:
+    return {
+        (req, r)
+        for req, (seq, q) in enumerate(zip(seq_lens, query_lens))
+        for r in range(seq // REGION)
+        if seq - q < (r + 1) * REGION <= seq
+    }
+
+
+def _random_batch(rng: torch.Generator) -> BatchSpec:
+    reqs = int(torch.randint(1, 7, (), generator=rng))
+    query_lens, seq_lens = [], []
+    for _ in range(reqs):
+        kind = int(torch.randint(0, 3, (), generator=rng))
+        q = (
+            1 + int(torch.randint(0, 4, (), generator=rng))  # decode / MTP verify
+            if kind == 0
+            else int(torch.randint(1, 300, (), generator=rng))  # (chunked) prefill
+        )
+        computed = 0 if kind == 1 else int(torch.randint(0, 500, (), generator=rng))
+        query_lens.append(q)
+        seq_lens.append(computed + q)
+    return BatchSpec(seq_lens=seq_lens, query_lens=query_lens)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+def test_completed_regions_matches_reference():
+    rng = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    for _ in range(500):
+        spec = _random_batch(rng)
+        m = create_common_attn_metadata(spec, block_size=16, device=torch.device("cpu"))
+        work = _completed_regions(m, REGION)
+        live = work[work[:, 0] >= 0]
+        got = {tuple(row) for row in live.tolist()}
+        assert len(got) == live.shape[0], "duplicate work rows"
+        assert got == _reference_regions(spec.seq_lens, spec.query_lens), spec
+        assert (work[live.shape[0] :] == -1).all(), "padding must trail live rows"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda_alike(), reason="token_to_req_indices is a GPU kernel"
+)
+def test_builder_positions_fallback():
+    """Spec-decode metadata carries no positions; the builder must derive them."""
+    spec = BatchSpec(seq_lens=[40, 9, 130], query_lens=[4, 9, 1])
+    m = create_common_attn_metadata(spec, block_size=16, device=torch.device("cuda"))
+    assert m.positions is None
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_text_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                sparse_config=SimpleNamespace(region_block_size=REGION)
+            )
+        ),
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_batched_tokens=64),
+    )
+    builder = Step5CSAMetadataBuilder(
+        SimpleNamespace(tokens_per_state=1), [], config, torch.device("cuda")
+    )
+    md = builder.build(0, m)
+    assert md.positions is not None and md.token_req is not None

+"""Step-5: Step-3.5 with compressed sparse attention (CSA) and an FP32 residual."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.distributed import (
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
+)
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import unified_kv_cache_update
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear, ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope
+from vllm.model_executor.models.step3p5 import (
+    Step3p5Attention,
+    Step3p5DecoderLayer,
+    Step3p5ForCausalLM,
+    Step3p5Model,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.step3p7 import Step3p7ForConditionalGeneration
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import WeightsMapper
+from vllm.models.step5.common.config import Step5Config
+from vllm.models.step5.common.csa_attention import step5_csa_attention
+from vllm.models.step5.common.csa_cache import (
+    Step5CSAIndexCache,
+    Step5CSASummaryCache,
+)
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.csa import indexer_norm
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import _encode_layer_name, kv_cache_dtype_str_to_dtype
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import AttentionBackend
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_unified_attn import (
+    RocmAiterUnifiedAttentionBackend,
+)
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+class Step5SparseIndexer(nn.Module):
+    """MQA indexer with ``heads_per_group`` query heads per KV group.
+
+    Q and W are sharded like the attention KV heads, so each rank computes only
+    its own groups; the shared single-head K and Z stay replicated.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Step5Config, layer_idx: int, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        sparse = config.sparse_config
+        assert sparse is not None
+        hidden = config.hidden_size
+        self.proxy_dim = sparse.proxy_dim
+        self.region_size = sparse.region_block_size
+        self.topk = sparse.topk
+        self.num_groups = sparse.num_provider_groups
+        self.heads_per_group = sparse.indexer_heads_per_group
+        self.eps = config.rms_norm_eps
+
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        group_shards = min(tp_size, self.num_groups)
+        group_rank = get_tensor_model_parallel_rank() * group_shards // tp_size
+        self.num_local_groups = self.num_groups // group_shards
+
+        def linear(name: str, out: int, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None):
+            return ReplicatedLinear(
+                hidden,
+                out,
+                bias=False,
+                params_dtype=dtype,
+                quant_config=None,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.{name}",
+            )
+
+        def group_linear(name: str, out: int, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None):
+            return ColumnParallelLinear(
+                hidden,
+                out,
+                bias=False,
+                params_dtype=dtype,
+                quant_config=None,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.{name}",
+                tp_rank=group_rank,
+                tp_size=group_shards,
+            )
+
+        heads = self.num_groups * self.heads_per_group
+        self.sparse_indexer_q = group_linear("sparse_indexer_q", heads * self.proxy_dim)
+        self.sparse_indexer_k = linear("sparse_indexer_k", self.proxy_dim)
+        self.sparse_indexer_z = linear("sparse_indexer_z", self.proxy_dim)
+        self.sparse_indexer_w = group_linear("sparse_indexer_w", heads, torch.float32)
+        self.sparse_indexer_q_norm = nn.Module()
+        self.sparse_indexer_q_norm.weight = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.zeros(self.proxy_dim, dtype=torch.float32), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.sparse_indexer_k_norm = nn.LayerNorm(
+            self.proxy_dim, eps=self.eps, dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+
+        theta = config.rope_theta
+        rope_parameters = dict(_rope_scaling(config, layer_idx) or {})
+        rope_parameters.setdefault("rope_type", "default")
+        rope_parameters["rope_theta"] = (
+            theta[layer_idx] if isinstance(theta, list) else theta
+        )
+        rope_parameters["partial_rotary_factor"] = (
+            sparse.sparse_indexer_rope_dim / self.proxy_dim
+        )
+        assert config.max_position_embeddings is not None
+        self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+            head_size=self.proxy_dim,
+            max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+            rope_parameters=rope_parameters,
+        )
+
+        vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        self.index_cache = Step5CSAIndexCache(
+            proxy_dim=self.proxy_dim,
+            cache_config=vllm_config.cache_config,
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.index_cache",
+        )
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "index_cache_scale", torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32), persistent=False
+        )
+        self.summary_cache = Step5CSASummaryCache(
+            proxy_dim=self.proxy_dim,
+            region_size=self.region_size,
+            cache_config=vllm_config.cache_config,
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.summary_cache",
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Returns ``(q [T, G, Hg, P], k [T, P], z [T, P], w [T, G, Hg])`` for
+        this rank's ``G`` local groups."""
+        tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        q, _ = self.sparse_indexer_q(hidden_states)
+        k, _ = self.sparse_indexer_k(hidden_states)
+        z, _ = self.sparse_indexer_z(hidden_states)
+        w, _ = self.sparse_indexer_w(hidden_states.float())
+        q, k = indexer_norm(
+            q.view(tokens, -1, self.proxy_dim),
+            k.view(tokens, 1, self.proxy_dim),
+            self.sparse_indexer_q_norm.weight,
+            self.sparse_indexer_k_norm.weight,
+            self.sparse_indexer_k_norm.bias,
+            self.eps,
+        )
+        q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q.flatten(1), k.flatten(1))
+        weights = w.view(tokens, self.num_local_groups, self.heads_per_group)
+        return (
+            q.view(tokens, self.num_local_groups, self.heads_per_group, self.proxy_dim),
+            k.view(tokens, self.proxy_dim),
+            z.view(tokens, self.proxy_dim),
+            weights * self.heads_per_group**-0.5,
+        )
+
+
+def _rope_scaling(config: Step5Config, layer_idx: int) -> dict | None:
+    yarn_only = getattr(config, "yarn_only_types", None)
+    if (
+        yarn_only
+        and config.layer_types
+        and config.layer_types[layer_idx] not in yarn_only
+    ):
+        return None
+    return getattr(config, "rope_scaling", None)
+
+
+class Step5Attention(Step3p5Attention):
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config.get_text_config()
+        self.indexer = None
+        if not config.is_sparse_layer(self.layer_idx):
+            return
+        cache_dtype = kv_cache_dtype_str_to_dtype(
+            vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype, vllm_config.model_config
+        )
+        if cache_dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                f"Step-5 sparse attention reads a BF16 KV cache; got {cache_dtype}"
+            )
+        if not self.use_rope:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Step-5 sparse layers require RoPE")
+        self.indexer = Step5SparseIndexer(
+            config, self.layer_idx, prefix=kwargs["prefix"]
+        )
+        self.csa_layer_name = f"{kwargs['prefix']}.csa"
+        static_context = vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        if self.csa_layer_name in static_context:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate layer name: {self.csa_layer_name}")
+        static_context[self.csa_layer_name] = self
+
+    def _attn_backend(self) -> type[AttentionBackend] | None:
+        # The CSA kernels read this backend's paged K/V layout.
+        config = get_current_vllm_config().model_config.hf_config.get_text_config()
+        if not config.is_sparse_layer(self.layer_idx):
+            return None
+        logger.info_once("Step-5 sparse attention layers use ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN.")
+        return RocmAiterUnifiedAttentionBackend
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.indexer is None:
+            return super().forward(positions, hidden_states)
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q = self.q_norm(q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)).view(q.shape)
+        k = self.k_norm(k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)).view(k.shape)
+        q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+        query = q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        k = k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        v = v.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        out = torch.empty_like(query)
+        attn_name = _encode_layer_name(self.attn.layer_name)
+        csa_name = _encode_layer_name(self.csa_layer_name)
+        if current_platform.opaque_attention_op():
+            kv_dep = torch.ops.vllm.unified_kv_cache_update(k, v, attn_name)
+            torch.ops.vllm.step5_csa_attention(
+                hidden_states, positions, query, out, csa_name, kv_dep
+            )
+        else:
+            kv_dep = unified_kv_cache_update(k, v, attn_name)
+            step5_csa_attention(hidden_states, positions, query, out, csa_name, kv_dep)
+        if self.use_head_wise_attn_gate:
+            gate, _ = self.g_proj(hidden_states)
+            out = out * gate.unsqueeze(-1).sigmoid().to(out.dtype)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(out.view(-1, self.q_size))
+        return output
+
+
+class Step5DecoderLayer(Step3p5DecoderLayer):
+    attention_cls = Step5Attention
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        dtype = self.self_attn.o_proj.weight.dtype
+        residual = hidden_states
+        hidden = self.input_layernorm(residual.to(dtype))
+        residual = residual + self.self_attn(positions, hidden).float()
+        hidden = self.post_attention_layernorm(residual.to(dtype))
+        ffn = self.moe(hidden) if self.use_moe else self.mlp(hidden)
+        return residual + ffn.float()
+

+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = make_empty_fp32

+        )

+"""Step-5 CSA as one graph-splitting custom op: index-cache write, region
+compression, scoring, top-k and sparse attention over the paged K/V."""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.step5.common.csa_cache import Step5CSAMetadata
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.csa import select_regions
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.csa_paged import (
+    compress_regions_paged,
+    indexer_scores_paged,
+    sparse_attention_paged,
+)
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import (
+    LayerNameType,
+    _resolve_layer_name,
+    direct_register_custom_op,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_attn import RocmAttentionMetadata
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.step5.amd.model import Step5Attention
+
+# Peak bytes per (row, group, region) across scoring and select_regions: FP32
+# scores, the masked copy and the sort's values, int64 indices and workspace.
+_SCORE_BYTES = 48
+
+
+def _rows_per_chunk(groups: int, max_regions: int) -> int:
+    budget = envs.VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB * 1024 * 1024
+    return max(1, budget // (_SCORE_BYTES * groups * max(max_regions, 1)))
+
+
+def step5_csa_attention(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+    kv_cache_dummy_dep: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    del kv_cache_dummy_dep
+    layer: Step5Attention = get_forward_context().no_compile_layers[
+        _resolve_layer_name(layer_name)
+    ]
+    metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    if isinstance(metadata, list):
+        metadata = metadata[0]
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
+        # Profiling run: caches are not bound yet; claim the scoring budget.
+        torch.empty(
+            envs.VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB * 1024 * 1024,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            device=output.device,
+        )
+        output.zero_()
+        return
+    indexer = layer.indexer
+    assert indexer is not None
+    index_md = metadata[indexer.index_cache.prefix]
+    summary_md = metadata[indexer.summary_cache.prefix]
+    main_md = metadata[layer.attn.layer_name]
+    assert isinstance(index_md, Step5CSAMetadata)
+    assert isinstance(summary_md, Step5CSAMetadata)
+    assert isinstance(main_md, RocmAttentionMetadata)
+    req, pos = index_md.token_req, index_md.positions
+    work = index_md.completed_regions
+    assert req is not None and pos is not None and work is not None
+    n = index_md.num_actual_tokens
+    output[n:].zero_()
+    if n == 0:
+        return
+
+    index_q, index_k, index_z, weights = indexer(hidden_states[:n], positions[:n])
+
+    index_pages = indexer.index_cache.pages
+    ops.concat_and_cache_mla(
+        index_k.to(index_pages.dtype),
+        index_z.to(index_pages.dtype),
+        index_pages,
+        index_md.slot_mapping[:n],
+        "auto",
+        indexer.index_cache_scale,
+    )
+
+    region_size = indexer.region_size
+    summary_pages = indexer.summary_cache.pages
+    compress_regions_paged(
+        index_pages,
+        summary_pages,
+        index_md.block_table,
+        summary_md.block_table,
+        work,
+        region_size=region_size,
+    )
+
+    max_regions = index_md.max_seq_len // region_size
+    regions = torch.empty(
+        (n, index_q.shape[1], indexer.topk + 1), dtype=torch.int32, device=query.device
+    )
+    step = _rows_per_chunk(index_q.shape[1], max_regions)
+    for start in range(0, n, step):
+        rows = slice(start, min(start + step, n))
+        scores = indexer_scores_paged(
+            index_q[rows],
+            weights[rows],
+            summary_pages,
+            summary_md.block_table,
+            req[rows],
+            pos[rows],
+            max_regions=max_regions,
+            region_size=region_size,
+        )
+        regions[rows] = select_regions(scores, pos[rows], region_size, indexer.topk)
+        del scores
+    key_cache, value_cache = layer.attn.kv_cache.transpose(1, 2).split(
+        layer.head_dim, dim=-1
+    )
+    sparse_attention_paged(
+        query[:n],
+        key_cache,
+        value_cache,
+        regions,
+        main_md.block_table,
+        req,
+        pos,
+        output[:n],
+        region_size=region_size,
+        scale=layer.scaling,
+    )
+
+
+def step5_csa_attention_fake(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+    kv_cache_dummy_dep: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    return
+
+
+direct_register_custom_op(
+    op_name="step5_csa_attention",
+    op_func=step5_csa_attention,
+    mutates_args=["output"],
+    fake_impl=step5_csa_attention_fake,
+)

+"""KV-cache-manager side caches for Step-5 CSA: per-token index rows and
+per-region summaries."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import ClassVar
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import CacheConfig, VllmConfig
+from vllm.config.cache import CacheDType
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention_layer_base import AttentionLayerBase
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import (
+    AttentionBackend,
+    AttentionCGSupport,
+    AttentionMetadata,
+    AttentionMetadataBuilder,
+    CommonAttentionMetadata,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    AttentionSpec,
+    KVCacheSpec,
+    MLAAttentionSpec,
+    SparseCacheRole,
+)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Step5CSAMetadata(AttentionMetadata):
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    query_start_loc_cpu: torch.Tensor
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+    num_actual_tokens: int
+    num_reqs: int
+    max_seq_len: int
+    token_req: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    positions: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    completed_regions: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+
+def _completed_regions(m: CommonAttentionMetadata, region_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``(request, region)`` pairs whose last token was cached this step.
+
+    Built on device from exact ``seq_lens``, padded with ``-1`` rows to a
+    host-known upper bound so the host never reads the count.
+    """
+    seq = m.seq_lens[: m.num_reqs]
+    first = torch.div(
+        m.compute_num_computed_tokens()[: m.num_reqs],
+        region_size,
+        rounding_mode="floor",
+    )
+    counts = (torch.div(seq, region_size, rounding_mode="floor") - first).clamp_min(0)
+    ends = torch.cumsum(counts, 0)
+    capacity = m.num_actual_tokens // region_size + m.num_reqs
+    slot = torch.arange(capacity, device=seq.device)
+    req = torch.searchsorted(ends, slot, right=True)
+    live = req < m.num_reqs
+    req = req.clamp_max(m.num_reqs - 1)
+    region = first[req] + slot - (ends - counts)[req]
+    work = torch.stack([torch.where(live, req, -1), torch.where(live, region, -1)], -1)
+    return work.to(torch.int32)
+

+        self.region_size = sparse.region_block_size
+        self.per_token = int(kv_cache_spec.tokens_per_state) == 1
+        self.token_req_buffer = torch.empty(
+            vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device=device,

+        self,
+        common_prefix_len: int,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        fast_build: bool = False,
+    ) -> Step5CSAMetadata:
+        del common_prefix_len, fast_build
+        m = common_attn_metadata
+        md = Step5CSAMetadata(
+            block_table=m.block_table_tensor,
+            slot_mapping=m.slot_mapping[: m.num_actual_tokens],
+            query_start_loc=m.query_start_loc,
+            query_start_loc_cpu=m.query_start_loc_cpu,
+            seq_lens=m.seq_lens,
+            num_actual_tokens=m.num_actual_tokens,
+            num_reqs=m.num_reqs,
+            max_seq_len=m.max_seq_len,
+        )
+        if not self.per_token:
+            return md
+        n = m.num_actual_tokens
+        md.token_req = m.token_to_req_indices(self.token_req_buffer)
+        if m.positions is None:
+            positions = (
+                m.compute_num_computed_tokens().index_select(0, md.token_req)
+                + torch.arange(n, device=md.token_req.device)
+                - m.query_start_loc.index_select(0, md.token_req)
+            )
+        else:
+            positions = m.positions[:n]
+        md.positions = positions.to(torch.int32)
+        md.completed_regions = _completed_regions(m, self.region_size)

+
+
+class Step5CSABackend(AttentionBackend):
+    supported_dtypes: ClassVar[list[torch.dtype]] = [torch.bfloat16]
+    supported_kv_cache_dtypes: ClassVar[list[CacheDType]] = ["auto", "bfloat16"]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_name() -> str:
+        return "STEP5_CSA_SIDE_CACHE"
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_impl_cls():
+        raise NotImplementedError("CSA side caches have no attention impl")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type[Step5CSAMetadataBuilder]:
+        return Step5CSAMetadataBuilder
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_sparse(cls) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_kv_connector(cls) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+
+class _Step5CSACache(nn.Module, AttentionLayerBase):
+    supports_dcp = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        width: int,
+        tokens_per_state: int,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if cache_config.block_size % tokens_per_state:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"KV block size {cache_config.block_size} must be a multiple of "
+                f"the CSA region size {tokens_per_state}"
+            )
+        self.width = width
+        self.tokens_per_state = tokens_per_state
+        self.cache_config = cache_config
+        self.prefix = prefix
+        self.kv_cache = torch.tensor([])
+        static_context = vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        if prefix in static_context:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate layer name: {prefix}")
+        static_context[prefix] = self
+
+    def forward(self) -> None: ...
+
+    @property
+    def pages(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.kv_cache.squeeze(1)
+
+    def get_attn_backend(self) -> type[AttentionBackend]:
+        return Step5CSABackend
+
+    def get_kv_cache_spec(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> KVCacheSpec:
+        del vllm_config
+        return MLAAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=self.cache_config.block_size,
+            num_kv_heads=1,
+            head_size=self.width,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            tokens_per_state=self.tokens_per_state,
+            cache_role=SparseCacheRole.INDEXER,
+        )
+
+
+class Step5CSAIndexCache(_Step5CSACache):
+    def __init__(self, *, proxy_dim: int, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(width=2 * proxy_dim, tokens_per_state=1, **kwargs)
+
+
+class Step5CSASummaryCache(_Step5CSACache):
+    def __init__(self, *, proxy_dim: int, region_size: int, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(width=proxy_dim, tokens_per_state=region_size, **kwargs)

+"""Step-5 CSA helpers shared by the paged kernels.
+
+Region selection depends on rounding to the OCP E4M3 grid, so it is done
+explicitly, also on gfx942 whose native FP8 is E4M3FNUZ.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+_OCP_E4M3 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+
+
+def round_e4m3(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Round to the OCP E4M3 grid, saturating like Triton's ``float8e4nv`` cast."""
+    x = x.to(torch.bfloat16).clamp(-448, 448)
+    return x.to(_OCP_E4M3).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def indexer_norm(
+    index_q: torch.Tensor,
+    index_k: torch.Tensor,
+    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_norm_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Zero-centred RMSNorm on ``index_q``, LayerNorm on ``index_k``, in FP32."""
+    dtype = index_q.dtype
+    q = index_q.float()
+    q = q * torch.rsqrt(q.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    q = q * (1.0 + q_norm_weight.float())
+    k = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(
+        index_k.float(),
+        (index_k.shape[-1],),
+        k_norm_weight.float(),
+        k_norm_bias.float(),
+        eps,
+    )
+    return q.to(dtype), k.to(dtype)
+
+
+def select_regions(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    region_size: int,
+    topk: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Top-``topk`` earlier regions plus the query's own, as ascending int32 ids
+    ``[T, G, topk + 1]`` padded with ``-1``. Ties pick the lower id."""
+    tokens, groups, regions = scores.shape
+    device = scores.device
+    own = torch.div(positions.long(), region_size, rounding_mode="floor")
+    visible = torch.arange(regions, device=device)[None, :] < own[:, None]
+    masked = scores.masked_fill(~visible[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
+
+    keep = min(topk, regions)
+    picked = torch.sort(masked, dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True).indices
+    picked = picked[..., :keep]
+    count = torch.clamp(own, max=topk).view(tokens, 1, 1)
+    slot = torch.arange(keep, device=device).view(1, 1, keep)
+    # Invisible picks sort last (sentinel = regions) and are then dropped.
+    picked = torch.where(slot < count, picked, regions)
+    picked = torch.sort(picked, dim=-1).values
+
+    out = torch.full((tokens, groups, topk + 1), -1, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
+    out[..., :keep] = picked.masked_fill(picked == regions, -1)
+    out.scatter_(
+        -1,
+        count.expand(tokens, groups, 1),
+        own.view(tokens, 1, 1).expand(tokens, groups, 1),
+    )
+    return out.to(torch.int32)

+"""Paged Step-5 CSA kernels; each cache has its own block table and page size."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.csa import round_e4m3
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _compress_paged_kernel(
+    index_ptr,
+    summary_ptr,
+    index_bt_ptr,
+    summary_bt_ptr,
+    work_ptr,
+    stride_index_bt,
+    stride_summary_bt,
+    stride_index_page,
+    stride_index_row,
+    stride_summary_page,
+    stride_summary_row,
+    INDEX_ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    SUMMARY_ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    REGION_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    PROXY_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    w = tl.program_id(0)
+    req = tl.load(work_ptr + 2 * w).to(tl.int64)
+    if req < 0:
+        return
+    region = tl.load(work_ptr + 2 * w + 1)
+    tokens = region * REGION_SIZE + tl.arange(0, REGION_SIZE)
+    page = tl.load(index_bt_ptr + req * stride_index_bt + tokens // INDEX_ROWS)
+    dims = tl.arange(0, PROXY_DIM)
+    base = (
+        index_ptr
+        + page.to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_index_page
+        + (tokens % INDEX_ROWS)[:, None] * stride_index_row
+        + dims[None, :]
+    )
+    k = tl.load(base).to(tl.float32)
+    z = tl.load(base + PROXY_DIM).to(tl.float32)
+    weights = tl.exp(z - tl.max(z, axis=0)[None, :])
+    summary = tl.sum(weights * k, axis=0) / tl.sum(weights, axis=0)
+    # Same rounding as ``round_e4m3``.
+    summary = summary.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float8e4nv).to(tl.bfloat16)
+    out_page = tl.load(
+        summary_bt_ptr + req * stride_summary_bt + region // SUMMARY_ROWS
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        summary_ptr
+        + out_page.to(tl.int64) * stride_summary_page
+        + (region % SUMMARY_ROWS) * stride_summary_row
+        + dims,
+        summary,
+    )
+
+
+def compress_regions_paged(
+    index_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    summary_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    index_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    summary_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    work: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    region_size: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Summarise the ``(request, region)`` pairs in ``work`` into the summary cache.
+
+    Caches are ``[pages, rows_per_page, width]`` views, each with its own block
+    table; index rows are ``[k | z]``. ``work`` rows with request ``-1`` are
+    skipped.
+    """
+    if work.shape[0] == 0:
+        return
+    _compress_paged_kernel[(work.shape[0],)](
+        index_cache,
+        summary_cache,
+        index_block_table,
+        summary_block_table,
+        work,
+        index_block_table.stride(0),
+        summary_block_table.stride(0),
+        index_cache.stride(0),
+        index_cache.stride(1),
+        summary_cache.stride(0),
+        summary_cache.stride(1),
+        INDEX_ROWS=index_cache.shape[1],
+        SUMMARY_ROWS=summary_cache.shape[1],
+        REGION_SIZE=region_size,
+        PROXY_DIM=summary_cache.shape[-1],
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _scores_paged_kernel(
+    q_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    summary_ptr,
+    block_table_ptr,
+    req_ptr,
+    pos_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    stride_q_token,
+    stride_q_group,
+    stride_q_head,
+    stride_w_token,
+    stride_w_group,
+    stride_summary_page,
+    stride_summary_row,
+    stride_bt,
+    stride_out_token,
+    stride_out_group,
+    max_regions,
+    HEADS_PER_GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    PROXY_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    SUMMARY_ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    REGION_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0)
+    group = tl.program_id(1)
+    regions = tl.program_id(2) * BLOCK_R + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+    req = tl.load(req_ptr + token).to(tl.int64)
+    history = tl.load(pos_ptr + token) // REGION_SIZE
+    live = regions < history
+    dims = tl.arange(0, PROXY_DIM)
+    page = tl.load(
+        block_table_ptr + req * stride_bt + regions // SUMMARY_ROWS,
+        mask=live,
+        other=0,
+    )
+    s = tl.load(
+        summary_ptr
+        + page.to(tl.int64)[None, :] * stride_summary_page
+        + (regions % SUMMARY_ROWS)[None, :] * stride_summary_row
+        + dims[:, None],
+        mask=live[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_R,), dtype=tl.float32)
+    for head in tl.static_range(HEADS_PER_GROUP):
+        q = tl.load(
+            q_ptr
+            + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_q_token
+            + group * stride_q_group
+            + head * stride_q_head
+            + dims
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        w = tl.load(
+            w_ptr + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_w_token + group * stride_w_group + head
+        )
+        acc += tl.maximum(tl.sum(q[:, None] * s, axis=0), 0.0) * w
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr
+        + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_out_token
+        + group * stride_out_group
+        + regions,
+        tl.where(live, acc, float("-inf")),
+        mask=regions < max_regions,
+    )
+
+
+def indexer_scores_paged(
+    index_q: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    summary_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    token_req: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    max_regions: int,
+    region_size: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``[T, G, Hg, P]`` queries vs each row's request history -> ``[T, G,
+    max_regions]`` scores; regions at or past a row's own region are ``-inf``."""
+    tokens, groups, heads_per_group, proxy_dim = index_q.shape
+    out = torch.full(
+        (tokens, groups, max(max_regions, 1)),
+        float("-inf"),
+        device=index_q.device,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+    )
+    if tokens == 0 or max_regions == 0:
+        return out
+    q = round_e4m3(index_q).contiguous()
+    w = weights.float().contiguous()
+    block_r = 64
+    _scores_paged_kernel[(tokens, groups, triton.cdiv(max_regions, block_r))](
+        q,
+        w,
+        summary_cache,
+        block_table,
+        token_req,
+        positions,
+        out,
+        q.stride(0),
+        q.stride(1),
+        q.stride(2),
+        w.stride(0),
+        w.stride(1),
+        summary_cache.stride(0),
+        summary_cache.stride(1),
+        block_table.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        out.stride(1),
+        max_regions,
+        HEADS_PER_GROUP=heads_per_group,
+        PROXY_DIM=proxy_dim,
+        SUMMARY_ROWS=summary_cache.shape[1],
+        REGION_SIZE=region_size,
+        BLOCK_R=block_r,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _attention_paged_kernel(
+    q_ptr,
+    k_cache_ptr,
+    v_cache_ptr,
+    regions_ptr,
+    block_table_ptr,
+    req_ptr,
+    pos_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    scale,
+    stride_q_token,
+    stride_q_head,
+    stride_k_page,
+    stride_k_row,
+    stride_k_head,
+    stride_v_page,
+    stride_v_row,
+    stride_v_head,
+    stride_r_token,
+    stride_r_group,
+    stride_bt,
+    stride_o_token,
+    stride_o_head,
+    HEADS_PER_GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_TOKENS: tl.constexpr,
+    REGION_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    SLOTS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0)
+    group = tl.program_id(1)
+    req = tl.load(req_ptr + token).to(tl.int64)
+    position = tl.load(pos_ptr + token)
+
+    heads = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    dims = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
+    head_ok = heads < HEADS_PER_GROUP
+    dim_ok = dims < HEAD_DIM
+    q = tl.load(
+        q_ptr
+        + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_q_token
+        + (group * HEADS_PER_GROUP + heads)[:, None] * stride_q_head
+        + dims[None, :],
+        mask=head_ok[:, None] & dim_ok[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    row_max = tl.full((BLOCK_H,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
+    row_sum = tl.zeros((BLOCK_H,), dtype=tl.float32)
+    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_H, BLOCK_D), dtype=tl.float32)
+    in_region = tl.arange(0, REGION_SIZE)
+
+    for base in tl.range(0, SLOTS, BLOCK_S):
+        slots = base + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_S)
+        ids = tl.load(
+            regions_ptr
+            + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_r_token
+            + group * stride_r_group
+            + slots,
+            mask=slots < SLOTS,
+            other=-1,
+        )
+        cols = tl.reshape(
+            ids[:, None] * REGION_SIZE + in_region[None, :], (BLOCK_S * REGION_SIZE,)
+        )
+        live = tl.reshape(
+            (ids[:, None] >= 0) & (in_region[None, :] >= 0), (BLOCK_S * REGION_SIZE,)
+        )
+        live = live & (cols <= position)
+        safe = tl.where(live, cols, 0)
+        page = tl.load(
+            block_table_ptr + req * stride_bt + safe // PAGE_TOKENS,
+            mask=live,
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+        row = (safe % PAGE_TOKENS).to(tl.int64)
+        kv_mask = live[:, None] & dim_ok[None, :]
+        k = tl.load(
+            k_cache_ptr
+            + page[:, None] * stride_k_page
+            + row[:, None] * stride_k_row
+            + group * stride_k_head
+            + dims[None, :],
+            mask=kv_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        v = tl.load(
+            v_cache_ptr
+            + page[:, None] * stride_v_page
+            + row[:, None] * stride_v_row
+            + group * stride_v_head
+            + dims[None, :],
+            mask=kv_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        s = tl.dot(q, tl.trans(k), out_dtype=tl.float32) * scale
+        s = tl.where(live[None, :], s, float("-inf"))
+        tile_max = tl.maximum(row_max, tl.max(s, axis=1))
+        empty = tile_max == float("-inf")
+        shift = tl.where(empty, 0.0, tile_max)
+        rescale = tl.where(empty, 1.0, tl.exp(row_max - shift))
+        p = tl.exp(s - shift[:, None])
+        row_sum = row_sum * rescale + tl.sum(p, axis=1)
+        acc = acc * rescale[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(v.dtype), v, out_dtype=tl.float32)
+        row_max = tile_max
+
+    out = tl.where(row_sum[:, None] > 0, acc / row_sum[:, None], 0.0)
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr
+        + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_o_token
+        + (group * HEADS_PER_GROUP + heads)[:, None] * stride_o_head
+        + dims[None, :],
+        out.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=head_ok[:, None] & dim_ok[None, :],
+    )
+
+
+def sparse_attention_paged(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    value_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    regions: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    token_req: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    region_size: int,
+    scale: float,
+) -> None:
+    """Attention over each query's selected regions of the paged K/V, into
+    ``output``. ``key_cache``/``value_cache`` are ``[pages, page_tokens, kv_heads,
+    head_dim]`` views; ``token_req`` and ``positions`` locate every query row."""
+    tokens, heads, head_dim = query.shape
+    if tokens == 0:
+        return
+    groups = key_cache.shape[2]
+    heads_per_group = heads // groups
+    _attention_paged_kernel[(tokens, groups)](
+        query,
+        key_cache,
+        value_cache,
+        regions,
+        block_table,
+        token_req,
+        positions,
+        output,
+        scale,
+        query.stride(0),
+        query.stride(1),
+        key_cache.stride(0),
+        key_cache.stride(1),
+        key_cache.stride(2),
+        value_cache.stride(0),
+        value_cache.stride(1),
+        value_cache.stride(2),
+        regions.stride(0),
+        regions.stride(1),
+        block_table.stride(0),
+        output.stride(0),
+        output.stride(1),
+        HEADS_PER_GROUP=heads_per_group,
+        HEAD_DIM=head_dim,
+        PAGE_TOKENS=key_cache.shape[1],
+        REGION_SIZE=region_size,
+        SLOTS=regions.shape[-1],
+        BLOCK_H=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(heads_per_group)),
+        BLOCK_D=triton.next_power_of_2(head_dim),
+        # 8 regions x 8 tokens x 256 padded dims fits gfx942's 64 KiB LDS.
+        BLOCK_S=8,
+        num_stages=1,
+    )

| MTP | Strict | Flexible |
|---:|---:|---:|
| No | 96.97% | 97.27% |

### Needle in a Haystack
RULER-style NIAH with 40 samples per task and context length, concurrency 1.
| Benchmark | MTP | 32K | 128K | 256K |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Single-key | No | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Single-key | 3 | 100% | 100% | 100% |

| Multikey-2 | 3 | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Multikey-3 | No | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Multikey-3 | 3 | 100% | 100% | 100% |
